items.html: And it is found that there still remained there, from the aspect of the Hod, Yesod, and Malchut of ZA, [aspects] that were not clarified completely, as above. And the reason is that they are adjacent to the shells, since they are lower ones; and in particular, because the NH are outside the body, and the judgments cling to them — and especially in Hod, in the secret of the thigh of Jacob — as is known from the verse, “all the day is she sick,” for from Hod is made “sick” [Dava].
